_about: AFFALTER W17: the steering wheel's screen (generics_lcd, its UVs a tile over: uv_wrap) shows the middle of its own picture (W13LCD2, 1024 px: columns 55 to 985, rows 236 to 788): a grid of empty boxes (lines at x 61, 111, 392, 586, 929, 966 and y 313, 413, 582, 680, 769; STRAT 1 under the middle one, LAP over the segmented bar at the right) with a bar at either side. Made live in its boxes: the gear in the big middle one, the speed to its left, the lap time to its right; the oil temperature and the fuel in litres in the top row, the water temperature bottom left; the revs climbing the left bar, the fuel the right one. Pixels of that picture. The model's steering column (generics.007, a rod 2.4 cm across from the dash to the wheel) runs 3 cm out through the middle of that screen: left out (drop_parts; box: m from the steering wheel's centre).
